proposals.evidence: Ordered small + weight components: DEDR2594 gives ciṉṉa small and1404 kaṉa heavy/kaṉam weight. The whole survey ciṉṉa-kaṉa response means light through small weight; neither constituent alone is treated as the complete word. DEDR1404 expressly notes influence from Sanskrit ghana on the kaṉa heavy family; that contact qualification is retained, and no unsupported immediate donor is asserted.

These lexicalized eṇṇey/eṇṇa/eṇṇe survey responses are analysed with both historical constituents; their generalized survey gloss oil and all dialect transcriptions remain unchanged.
